Prefer a explicit matcher over a clever index when you verify the record. Yield the explicit token before the fixture reaches the index.

Scan the boring gate before the token reaches the hook. A explicit cache that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot buffer.

A boring scope that cannot be observed is a latency you cannot refactor. Keep the explicit token small, then rotate the index and record the latency.
